description: This file provides a final class 'MqttSpecificConfig' that encapsulates MQTT-specific configuration settings for a messaging service. It handles parsing configuration parameters related to MQTT connection modes, client identifiers, and reconnection behaviors, using the Typesafe Config library and is designed for use within a larger Eclipse Ditto project.

classes.name: MqttSpecificConfig
classes.description: Immutable class providing access to MQTT specific configuration parameters such as session behavior, client IDs, and redelivery delays.

methods.name: fromConnection
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate 'MqttSpecificConfig' using a Connection object from which specific configuration is extracted.

methods.name: cleanSession
methods.description: Determines whether the MQTT session should be clean, inversely related to 'reconnectForRedelivery' setting.

methods.name: reconnectForRedelivery
methods.description: Indicates whether redelivery reconnect behavior is enabled, defaulting to true.

methods.name: separatePublisherClient
methods.description: Indicates whether to use a separate MQTT client for the publisher to avoid disconnect issues.

methods.name: getReconnectForDeliveryDelay
methods.description: Returns the duration to wait before reconnecting for redelivery.

methods.name: getMqttClientId
methods.description: Optional MQTT client ID configured for connection.

methods.name: getMqttPublisherId
methods.description: Optional publisher ID used as client identifier for publishing.
